title: Kissed Thai Yeast Tom Yum
description: A yeasty, chewy twist on the classic Tom Yum soup. Perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Combine yeast, rice flour, and 1/4 cup of warm water in a blender. Blend until a smooth batter forms.
Transfer the batter to a mixing bowl and add the remaining 1 cup of water, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, lemongrass, and Tom Yum paste. Mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the mixture ferment for 2 hours.
Heat a small amount of water in a saucepan and add the Binchotan charcoal tablet. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add the fermented mixture to the saucepan and stir well.
Add the coconut milk and baby corn. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
Note: Binchotan charcoal can be found at most Asian markets or online. It adds a unique, smoky flavor to the dish.
